validity_limits: DROID original development data already revealed; no fresh/reserved/test evaluation.
External 100 epochs, batch 32, FP32 constant LR 5e-4 vs internal 30 epochs; unequal training budgets.
Pooled 16-token DINOv2-small features, grouped 35D DROID commands, no proprioception, three observations and preprocessing differ from official native-patch benchmarks.
Raw-coordinate inputs/loss/recursion, optimizer schedule, batch size, precision and training budget changed jointly versus v1; no causal attribution to one change.
Official shifted-one-step objective and recursive H10 control optimize different target sets; recursive H10 is not the official objective.
Checkpoints are earliest best common all-ten window-weighted standardized development score, while paper aggregate errors use equal windows within episode/equal episodes/equal seeds.
Both adapted objectives underperform simple persistence; investigate interface/representation/optimization before presenting any external superiority headline.
Sufficient application/source evidence verifies completed training, but unavailable Slurm accounting prevents independently reporting exact scheduler exit codes.
